bull_bear.body:
- FY26 balance-sheet and return markers as stated on the dashboard slide: Debt/Equity 0.56x, ROCE 14.50%, CFO Rs 19.09 Cr.
- Capital has gone into capacity and a JV rather than payouts - the deck states no dividend, buyback or payout policy anywhere, and describes "Consistent execution across capacity expansion, new product launches and customer additions" and "Consistent growth powered by continuous investments in modern technology".
- The injection-moulding growth engine is entered asset-light: the deck describes "1 Dedicated Injection Moulding Partner" and "Entered the Injection Moulding business through an exclusive toll manufacturing agreement" rather than owned capacity.
- The second platform is EBITDA-positive but loss-making below it: Olive Ecopak FY26 Revenue from Operations Rs 52.67 Cr with EBITDA Rs 2.20 Cr (4.18% margin) and Profit After Tax of (18.89) Cr; FY25 comparatives were revenue Rs 16.37 Cr, EBITDA (8.28) Cr and PAT (22.63) Cr.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Market leader in Thermoformed Rigid Packaging in India" with "20+ Years of expertise in Food Packaging", "BRC & Sedex Certified Quality Standards" and four "Design & Process Patents".
- The barrier-packaging first-mover claim is stated two different ways in the same deck and both readings are quoted as given: the overview slide says "India's first vertically integrated 9 layer barrier packaging", while the investment case says "First in India to introduce 11-layer rigid PP/EVOH & PS/EVOH barrier packaging for MAP and retort applications" and the milestone timeline says "Became the first company in India with a vertically integrated 11-layer rigid barrier packaging manufacturing facility".
- Integration is the stated moat: "Integrated capabilities across extrusion, thermoforming, printing, sleeving and injection moulding", having "Achieved vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities under one roof".
- Customer positioning: "Supplies packaging solutions to leading multinational companies across the food, dairy, confectionery, sweets and beverages sectors" with "Repeat orders from marquee global Companies"; FY26 Top 5 Customer Revenues were 30.65%.
- Global reach stated as 14 "Countries served Across the globe", "11 Locations Mapped" and "5 Continents Served", with an FY26 India revenue mix of 79.00%.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [JV structure] Olive Ecopak Private Limited is a "JV Between Rajshree Polypack and Mr. Rajesh Gandhi (Oracle Polyplast)", described as "India's 1st Vertically integrated, state-of-the-art facility for eco-friendly, paper-based tableware and packaging solutions", located at Umbergaon.
- [Reporting basis] The RPPL performance table is explicitly labelled "(Standalone)" and Olive Ecopak's numbers are presented in a separate table, so the RPPL revenue figures and Olive Ecopak's Rs 52.67 Cr FY26 revenue are on different bases and are not combined here.
- [Listing history] "Listed on NSE emerge through IPO (2018)"; incorporated in 2003 as a partnership firm named 'Rajshree Industries'.
- [Market context] "India's packaging industry expected to reach US$92 billion by FY30", described as the "5th Largest Sector of Indian Economy", with demand from packaged food, dairy, QSR and organised retail.
- [Go-to-market] Trade-show presence listed as Aahar (Delhi, March 2026), Interpack (Germany, May 2026), NRA / National Restaurant Association Show (Chicago, May 2026 and May 2025), Pack Expo (Las Vegas, Oct 2025) and Anugha Anutec (Mumbai, August 2025).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Rajshree Polypack as a 20+ year, vertically integrated rigid food-packaging manufacturer - "Market leader in Thermoformed Rigid Packaging in India" - now scaling injection moulding and exports as a second growth engine while building a paper-based compostable packaging platform through the Olive Ecopak joint venture.
